acceptance_criteria: Probe failure, checkpoint-storage read failure, complete empty, and complete nonempty are mutually exclusive validated wire-result variants.
The wire validator rejects missing required fields, contradictory flags, and unknown availability or reason codes.
The Agents page renders storage-read unavailable without a numeric zero or a no-live-sessions claim, while preserving the existing honest probe-failure state.
Line detail explains unavailable live-process evidence, and query transport freshness remains distinct from source-result availability.
Recovery to a complete empty snapshot produces an explicit transition, and unavailable or stale evidence cannot authorize destructive actions.
blast_radius: Operator liveness decisions for per-chat agent sessions across the Agents and line-detail surfaces; a storage outage can otherwise masquerade as a fresh authoritative zero.

impact: Checkpoint-storage failure appears as zero live sessions with fresh query timing, concealing unavailable evidence when an operator assesses a stalled turn or future recovery action.
